data.title: CleanSpark Stock Slides After Revenue Drop And Bitcoin Output Update
data.description: CleanSpark reported unaudited bitcoin production of 529 coins for September and 5,432 for the year to September 30, 2026, alongside weaker fiscal Q3 results that included revenue of US$138.01 million and a net loss of US$239.84 million.
